Chapter 6568: Entering The Primordial

Chapter 6568: Entering The Primordial

Spectators capable of seeing her were shocked.

“Desolate Ancestor is here...” Those who couldn’t see through the abyss kneeled in respect after feeling her immortal aura.

She never intended to hurt anyone with her aura, not even an ant. Nevertheless, most still willingly showed their respect in the absence of pressure.

They never forgot the founder of their cultivation path - a feat that has benefited Three Immortals for ages.

Alas, no one could see her clearly without her permission, not even overlords with activated heavenly gaze.

Nevertheless, her immortal silhouette and gentle aura were more than enough to leave an indelible impression.

Some were moved to tears. This moment was beautiful, a great honor lasting a lifetime.

She didn’t give chase and entered Primordial Gate instead, surprising everyone.

“To see the tree?” A primal ancestor murmured while watching her departing figure.

This gate was rumored to be the only way to reach the actual tree. Legends of those who saw the tree and cultivated beneath it existed. However, perhaps it was not the actual tree.

First Vine possessed the portal but lent it to the redemption grounds later, hence Xian Chengtian’s current possession of it.

Now, everyone wondered why she wanted to enter.

“This is bad!” Weizhen realized something and became alarmed.

“Buzz.” A primordial power took over Three Immortals, boosting everyone’s cultivation temporarily before flowing toward Desolate Ancestor.

“Clank!” The intimidating hymn of a saber could be heard.

“Calamitous Edge!” The saber intent permeated across the dimension, reaching the high heaven above.

The blade alone put an end to the immortal Bao Pu. Now, she was present to swing the blade herself.

Countless primordial trees appeared before the slash. Supreme overlords couldn’t tell which was the real one.

They fell one by one as she entered the first of the primordial trees. This was akin to a master woodcutter with the sharpest machete capable of cutting down towering trees. However, he couldn’t cut down the whole forest in a short time.

“What is going on?” Capable spectators became confused.

Everyone knew her cultivation system originated from the primordial tree. It was the foundation of the dao search. Therefore, a strong connection existed between her and the tree.

Was she trying to end their world’s cultivation path?

“No, it’s Zhan Sansheng, she’s trying to slay Zhan Sansheng!” A primal ancestor shouted.

Others immediately understood and recalled Xian Chengtian’s revelation - the fourth reincarnation of Zhan Sansheng would take place at the primordial tree. Perhaps this confirmed it.

“So it’s really happening.” An overlord murmured in a daze.

Zhan Sansheng’s greatness couldn’t be overstated, becoming immortal in three lifetimes. His path originated from an ancient immortal and was separated from the current system.

He competed against Desolate Ancestor whose backing was the primordial tree. Thus, he wanted to burn it.

Therefore, it seemed absurd that his fourth reincarnation would take place at the tree.

“If he’s parasitizing the tree, is there still an antagonistic relationship?” A heaven-slayer wondered.

He had spent his previous lives fighting against Desolate Ancestor and the primordial tree. However, would he still be an enemy now?
